effects.does: Clicking Ask Clara opens the AI assistance interface for generating RFP questions.
effects.affects: It may create or update AI-generated questions for the event.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the AI assistance interface opens.

effects.does: Clicking Add Attachments opens the attachment control.
effects.affects: It allows files to be added to the event data.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify that a file-selection control appears.

effects.does: Clicking Add T&Cs opens the terms and conditions control.
effects.affects: It adds or changes the terms and conditions shown to participating vendors.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and conditions drawer or dialog
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify that saved or custom terms can be selected.

effects.does: Clicking Items 2 opens the event's two line items.
effects.affects: It allows the event line-item records to be reviewed or edited.
effects.check: Click Items 2 and verify that two line items are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Save as draft saves the event without publishing it.
effects.affects: It creates or updates the draft event and preserves its line items and stage data for later editing.
effects.check: Click Save as draft and verify that the event remains unpublished and can be reopened as a draft.

effects.does: Clicking Publish starts the event publication flow.
effects.affects: It changes the event from draft preparation toward an active or auction-team publication state after confirmation.
effects.leadsTo: Publish confirmation dialog or published event state
effects.check: Click Publish and verify that the publication confirmation shows the project title and stage schedule.

effects.does: Clicking RFQ selects the RFQ event mode.
effects.affects: It changes the current stage mode and can reset incompatible existing event data.
effects.check: Click RFQ and verify that RFQ configuration is selected.

effects.does: Clicking Buy Template opens template selection.
effects.affects: It allows a template to be selected for the current stage.
effects.check: Click Buy Template and verify that available templates are shown.

effects.does: Clicking Add Columns opens column-selection controls.
effects.affects: It changes which bid or item columns are displayed in the event grid.
effects.check: Click Add Columns and verify that selectable columns are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Details opens the event details controls.
effects.affects: It allows event-detail data to be viewed or edited.
effects.check: Click Details and verify that event detail fields are visible.

effects.does: Clicking Price Components opens the price-component controls.
effects.affects: It allows the event's price or amount components to be viewed or configured.
effects.check: Click Price Components and verify that price-component fields or rows appear.

effects.does: Clicking Invite Vendor opens vendor invitation controls.
effects.affects: It allows vendors to be added to the event audience.
effects.check: Click Invite Vendor and verify that vendors can be searched and invited.

effects.does: Clicking Participants opens the participant list or participant controls.
effects.affects: It allows the event audience and invited vendors to be reviewed or changed.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that the event's participant list is displayed.

effects.does: Clicking QA_Platform Vendor 1 1790820862139 selects or opens that vendor participant.
effects.affects: It changes the currently focused participant record.
effects.leadsTo: Vendor participant details or selected participant state
effects.check: Click the vendor control and verify that this vendor becomes selected or its details open.

effects.does: Clicking Clear clears the current participant or vendor selection.
effects.affects: It removes the current vendor selection from the participant control without necessarily deleting the vendor from the event.
effects.check: Click Clear and verify that the selected vendor value is removed.

effects.does: Clicking Savings opens the savings configuration or value.
effects.affects: It allows event savings information to be viewed or changed.
effects.check: Click Savings and verify that savings-related controls are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Terms & Conditions opens the terms and conditions controls.
effects.affects: It changes the terms and conditions attached to the event and shown to vendors.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and conditions drawer or dialog
effects.check: Click Terms & Conditions and verify that the current terms and available edits are shown.

effects.does: Clicking the schedule chip opens the event scheduling controls.
effects.affects: It allows the stage start, end, duration, and evaluation schedule to be changed.
effects.check: Click the schedule chip and verify that the displayed start and end schedule can be edited.

effects.does: Clicking Back leaves the schedule editor without saving its current changes.
effects.affects: It discards unsaved schedule changes.
effects.check: Change a schedule value, click Back, and verify that the change is not stored.

effects.does: Clicking Save Schedule saves the current schedule configuration.
effects.affects: It stores the stage's scheduling values and, for a recurring event, applies the recurring configuration to every stage.
effects.leadsTo: Event-creation screen with the updated schedule
effects.check: Change the schedule, click Save Schedule, and verify that the updated schedule chip is shown.

effects.does: Clicking Technical Stage selects the technical stage tab.
effects.affects: It changes the currently displayed event stage.
effects.check: Click Technical Stage and verify that its stage content is displayed.

effects.does: Clicking RFQ selects the RFQ stage tab.
effects.affects: It changes the currently displayed stage to the RFQ stage.
effects.check: Click the RFQ tab and verify that it remains selected and its RFQ content is shown.

effects.does: Clicking Events navigates to the events list.
effects.affects: Nothing in the current event data.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the events list opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Filling the project title field sets the event or project title.
effects.affects: It changes the title saved with the draft or published event.
effects.check: Enter a title and save the event, then verify that the same title appears in the event record.

effects.does: The disabled Select date field cannot be edited.
effects.affects: Nothing because the date value cannot currently be changed through this control.
effects.check: Attempt to click or type in Select date and verify that no date picker or value change occurs.

effects.does: Filling Select time sets the event start time.
effects.affects: It changes the stage schedule used to calculate the event ending time.
effects.check: Select a time and verify that the schedule summary reflects the chosen start time.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Selecting a vendor from Search vendors you want to add adds that vendor to the participant selection.
effects.affects: It adds the vendor's company UUID to the event audience.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here with the vendor selected
effects.check: Search for a vendor, select it, and verify that the vendor appears in the participant list.

effects.does: Selecting Start now configures the stage to begin immediately.
effects.affects: It changes the schedule start mode from a fixed start to a now-based start.
effects.check: Select Start now and verify that the schedule summary begins with Now.

effects.does: Selecting Duration chooses the event's duration or fixed-time scheduling option.
effects.affects: It changes the stage ending time or duration used during save and publication.
effects.check: Open Duration and verify that the configured duration options are displayed.

effects.control: Mark as Recurring EventSet this event to repeat automaticall
effects.does: Turning on the recurring-event switch enables recurring scheduling.
effects.affects: It changes the stage configuration to include recurring schedule settings and repeated event behavior.
effects.check: Turn on the switch and verify that recurring schedule options appear.

effects.does: Selecting a product fills the Product cell for the line item.
effects.affects: Sets the line item's product selection, including its product identifier.
effects.check: Select a product and verify its name remains in the Product cell.

effects.does: Selecting a product variant fills the Product Variant cell for the line item.
effects.affects: Sets the line item's product quality or variant identifier.
effects.check: Select a variant and verify it remains displayed for the selected product.

effects.does: Entering a quantity fills the Quantity Requested cell.
effects.affects: Sets the requested quantity for the line item.
effects.check: Enter a quantity and verify the same value is displayed in the row.

effects.does: Entering or selecting a delivery location fills the Delivery location cell.
effects.affects: Sets the delivery-location value for the line item.
effects.check: Set a delivery location and verify it remains displayed in the row.

effects.does: Entering a price fills the Price cell.
effects.affects: Sets the line item's price value used in the event data.
effects.check: Enter a price and verify the value and selected currency prefix are displayed.

effects.does: Entering a quantity fills the Quantity Available cell.
effects.affects: Sets the quantity available for the line item.
effects.check: Enter an available quantity and verify it remains displayed in the row.

effects.does: Entering or selecting GST fills the GST cell.
effects.affects: Sets the tax value for the line item.
effects.check: Enter or select a GST value and verify it remains displayed in the row.

effects.does: Entering a total amount fills the Total Amount cell.
effects.affects: Sets the line item's total amount value.
effects.check: Enter a total amount and verify it is displayed in the row with the selected currency.

cases.title: Duration shows the configured preset values
cases.expected: The menu contains the configured duration presets, or the defaults 30 mins, 1 hour, 4 hours, and 24 hours. The schedule summary reflects the selected duration.
cases.setup: Open the schedule drawer for an RFQ event using the default duration configuration.
gaps: Verify the complete set of available duration presets, including the configured values or the exact defaults of 30 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours, and 24 hours.
Verify that the schedule summary displays the exact duration preset selected.

cases.title: Recurring event changes the Publish label
steps: Turn on Mark as Recurring EventSet this event to repeat automaticall.
cases.expected: The action label changes from "Publish" to "Save Recurring Event".
cases.setup: Open a new RFQ event that is not currently recurring.

cases.title: Required line-item columns are marked
steps: Review the column headers in the items grid.
Compare the required markers on each header.
cases.expected: Product, Product Variant, Quantity Requested, Delivery location, Price, Quantity Available, and Total Amount show required markers. GST does not show a required marker.
cases.setup: Open a new RFQ event with the items grid visible.
gaps: Whether Product, Product Variant, Quantity Requested, Delivery location, Price, Quantity Available, and Total Amount headers show required markers
Whether the GST header lacks a required marker
